description: This Rust source file defines a ConfigSet struct for managing in-memory caches of configuration files like .gitconfig. It includes methods for adding files, retrieving integer and string values, and handles external C library calls. It also contains unit tests for its functionality.

classes.name: ConfigSet
classes.description: A struct representing an in-memory cache for configuration files, wrapping a pointer to a libgit_config_set.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new ConfigSet by allocating a new libgit_config_set.

methods.name: add_files
methods.description: Loads multiple configuration files into the ConfigSet, overriding conflicting directives.

methods.name: get_int
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key as an i32, or None if not present.

methods.name: get_string
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key as a String, or None if not present.
